documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for BOARD MEETING TO BE HELD ON 04.11.2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited reported a significant revenue increase to Rs. 849,933 lakhs in FY 2025-26, supported by organic growth and strong contributions from newly operated Chennai retail outlets. EBITDA reached Rs. 57,674 lakhs and PAT rose to Rs. 35,165 lakhs, benefiting from better cost versus price management models and higher gold and silver prices.

guidance.claim: The management plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
guidance.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

guidance.claim: The customer base is slated to increase to 40 lakhs by March 31, 2026.
guidance.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

orders_capacity.claim: Maximum operational retail space exceeded 100,000 square feet in February 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Maximum operational Retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft (February 2025)

orders_capacity.claim: The customer base grew to 32 lakhs in FY 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: Growth in customer base to 32 lakhs

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued a Rights Issue raising gross proceeds of Rs. 510,000 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The Rights issue, gross amount of 5,10,000 lakhs was taken to reserves net of issue expenses of 224 lakhs and the consolidated Net Worth post merging of operational results of 24-25FY currently stands at 1,10,235 lakhs

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the Rights issue sum of Rs. 50,776 lakhs, only a sum of Rs. 2,924 lakhs remained unutilized as on May 14, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of the said sum of 50,776 lakhs only a sum of 2,924 lakhs remaining unutilized as on 14/05/25, All the formalities governing the monitoring of the utilisation of the funds collected are complied with.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 6 per share of face value of Rs. 10.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board after considering the funding requirements for 2024-25 both for capex and enlarged working capital requirements due to gold price increase by 12%, has recommended a final dividend of ` 6/- per share of face value of Rs.10/- aggregating to Rs.10/- per share as total distribution of dividend for the financial year 2023-24 on the doubled equity capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Vertical rises in gold prices restrict sales as customers are unsure about price sustenance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The adverse impact on vertical rise in gold price restricts the sale by the company as customers are not sure about the sustenance of price

risks_headwinds.claim: Unhealthy competition prevails in the market as the overall size of the market in volume terms shrinks modestly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Continued unhealthy competition prevailing in the market as the over all size of the market in volume terms shrinking modestly.

management_commitments.claim: The management plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
management_commitments.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

management_commitments.claim: The customer base is slated to increase to 40 lakhs by March 31, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open a flagship Chennai outlet by January 2025.
management_commitments.quote: To open flagship Chennai outlet by Jan 2025.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete geographical expansion in an additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.
management_commitments.quote: To complete geographical expansion in additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to improve the stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
